tools.purpose: Inspect repositories, services, modules, data flows, and deployment topology.
forbidden_actions: Infer missing services from naming alone.
tools.failure_boundary: If topology is incomplete, mark the architecture map partial.

allowed_actions: Identify cycles and shared failure domains.
forbidden_actions: Treat graph reachability as proof of runtime coupling.
tools.failure_boundary: Dynamic or hidden dependencies remain an explicit unknown.
Conflicting decisions require explicit supersession or HOLD.

tools.purpose: Model quality-attribute scenarios, failure paths, and migration sequences.
forbidden_actions: Present model output as measured production behavior.
tools.failure_boundary: Model results are INFERRED unless validated by execution or measurement.
